details: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points, lifting its federal funds target range to 3.75%-4.00%. This move, the first hike since July 2023, was a response to persistent inflationary pressures and was widely anticipated. Bitcoin and the broader cryptocurrency market experienced downward pressure, with Bitcoin initially slipping below $76,000, as higher rates typically reduce appetite for risk assets and strengthen the dollar.
title: US Federal Reserve Hikes Rates, Dampening Crypto Sentiment

details: The U.S. Senate failed to advance the "Clarity Act," a crucial bill aimed at establishing a regulatory framework for digital assets. The measure fell short of the 60 votes needed, marking a significant setback for the crypto industry seeking clearer rules for exchanges and token classifications. This legislative stumble has further weakened market sentiment and contributes to ongoing regulatory uncertainty.
title: US Senate Fails to Advance Crypto Regulatory "Clarity Act"

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) has opened a call for e-commerce and mobile commerce merchants in the euro area to participate in a 12-month pilot program for the digital euro. Expected to begin in the second half of 2027, the pilot will test a beta version of the digital currency in a simulated environment. This initiative is a step towards shaping the future of digital payments in Europe, though no decision on issuing a digital euro has been made yet.
title: ECB Invites Merchants for Digital Euro Pilot Program

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has advised the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to remain prepared to raise interest rates if necessary, citing persistent upside risks to inflation. The IMF also suggested that the Australian government could contribute to slowing inflation by tightening fiscal policy. This reflects a continued global focus on combating inflation through monetary and fiscal measures.
title: IMF Urges RBA to Maintain Rate-Hike Bias on Inflation Risks

details: Circle Internet Group, Inc. has announced the public mainnet launch of Arc, an open Layer 1 blockchain specifically designed for financial markets, real-time money movement, and agentic economic activity. Arc integrates natively with Circle's platform, including USDC, and features a founding validator cohort of global financial institutions, indicating a push towards institutional adoption of blockchain technology for traditional finance.
title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet for Financial Markets

details: Binance is actively participating in discussions and initiatives to build the payment layer beneath South Africa's smart cities. At "The Gathering: Cities Edition" event, Binance highlighted its existing tools that facilitate everyday digital finance, addressing barriers like understanding, onboarding, and cost. This demonstrates a growing real-world application and adoption of cryptocurrency infrastructure in emerging markets.
title: Binance Integrates Payments into South Africa's Smart Cities

details: Americans for Financial Reform (AFR), along with various allies, sent a letter to Congress opposing H.R. 10357, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act. They argue the legislation includes special tax benefits and loopholes for digital assets and fails to achieve clarity and parity in digital asset taxation. This highlights ongoing political and advocacy efforts around crypto regulation and its financial implications.
title: Americans for Financial Reform Opposes Special Crypto Tax Treatments
